issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual description) specifies acceptSupplyDelivery should take four parameters (supplier name, ingredient name, price, quantity), but the template's example (Main.java) and the solution implement acceptSupplyDelivery with only three parameters (ingredient name, price, quantity). This discrepancy in the method signature can confuse students about the correct method to implement and cause mismatches with provided examples/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the acceptSupplyDelivery signature consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement UML and textual description to specify three parameters (ingredient name, price, quantity) to match the template and solution; or (B) update the template Main and the solution SealSaloon to add the supplierName String parameter (even if unused) so the method signature becomes acceptSupplyDelivery(String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity). Ensure tests and examples are updated accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement's UML and description define acceptSupplyDelivery with four parameters (supplier name, ingredient name, price, quantity) — acceptSupplyDelivery(String, String, int, int) — but the provided template/sample usage and the solution implement and call acceptSupplyDelivery with three parameters (ingredient name, price, quantity). This parameter-count/name mismatch for the same conceptual operation (registering a supply delivery) creates confusion: students reading the problem may implement or expect a different method signature than the one used in starter code and reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement/UML to show acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) (matching the template/sample and solution), or update the template and solution to implement and call acceptSupplyDelivery(String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity). Ensure examples and tests use the same parameter list.
